title: Monotonicity of quadratic noise
statement: Let $I$ be a finite set with weights $w_i\in\bbr$ satisfying $w_i\ge0$ for every $i$ and $\sum_{i\in I}w_i=1$. For $\rho,\sigma\in\bbr$ with $0\le\rho\le\sigma$ and any $g:I\to\bbr$, one has $\rho^2\sum_{i\in I}w_i g_i^2+(1-\rho^2)(\sum_{i\in I}w_i g_i)^2\le\sigma^2\sum_{i\in I}w_i g_i^2+(1-\sigma^2)(\sum_{i\in I}w_i g_i)^2$.
replaced: Let $I$ be a finite set with nonnegative weights $w_i$ satisfying $\sum_iw_i=1$, and let $g:I\to\mathbb R$ and $0\le\rho\le\sigma$. Then $\rho^2\sum_iw_ig_i^2+(1-\rho^2)(\sum_iw_ig_i)^2\le\sigma^2\sum_iw_ig_i^2+(1-\sigma^2)(\sum_iw_ig_i)^2$.
